snippet.title: FANTASY VII REVELATION | Combat and Exploration Deep Dive Trailer
snippet.description:
Final Fantasy VII Revelation launches April 8, 2027 on PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Steam, and Epic Games Store.

A vast planet awaits. Explore the world like never before - take flight aboard the Highwind, descend directly into adventure, and traverse vast landscapes with chocobos and the new grappling gun. Build your ideal party with the FITS system, unleash powerful synergies, and prepare for the final chapter of the FINAL FANTASY VII Remake Series.
